layers.authority: Pilgrims' Bureau of the Holy Executive of Mount Athos (Ouranoupoli)
layers.process: A diamonitirion (entry permit), for men only. Reported daily quota of about 10 non-Orthodox visitors (about 100 Orthodox); usually 3 nights; book well ahead and collect in person at Ouranoupoli on the morning of the boat. Reported fee about €30 (about A$48 at RBA, 30 October 2026: A$1 = €0.6293).

zone-requirements.note: Confirm quota, fee and booking with the Pilgrims' Bureau.
